info.title: TXAPI HTTP contracts
info.description: TXAPI control console and S5 first-batch billing contracts. Management uses session Bearer; model calls use API-key Bearer. Publication revisions are per-process and scoped by epoch. billing.mode=legacy retains availability-first quota behavior, disabled bypasses monetary quota/charging, and strict requires immutable price history, durable balances and a configured per-request user-fee ceiling. Strict reserves the entire ceiling atomically for user and key, settles known final usage once, and retains uncertain/over-ceiling charges for reconciliation. The ceiling bounds collected user charges, not absolute provider spend. Ordinary logs remain droppable and are not the strict ledger. Strict currently supports text chat (explicit single output limit, n=1, no paid tools/media/unknown extensions) and text embeddings only. Administrator-session-only ledger queries and audited resolution of expired pending holds are available. A repeated identical resolution is idempotent; a conflicting one returns 409. Known excess cost requires an explicit cap_usage decision; unknown cost may only be explicitly waived with evidence. Disabled billing permits read-only inspection. Monetary ledger units are decimal strings (1e9 units per currency).

409.description: Lease/state not resolvable, verified cost exceeds hold without explicit cap, or a conflicting decision already exists. No balance change.

post.description: The reservation must be pending with an expired lease. The decision, both balances and terminal state commit together. settle_usage charges verified historical cost only within the hold. cap_usage requires verified cost above the hold, charges exactly the hold and records the excess. waive releases the hold without claiming execution was free. Reasons/evidence are immutable; identical semantic input replays the original decision/actor, conflicts never overwrite it. Existing automatically settled requests cannot be rewritten.

concurrency_limit.description: Per-process forwarding concurrency. 0 inherits the finite server ceiling; a positive value may lower it. User limits are shared across all owned Keys. Key creation/update also inherits and cannot exceed a nonzero owner limit. In-flight requests retain their leases; new limits apply on the next authenticated request. See DEVELOPMENT.md.

expires_in_seconds.description: Relative expiry from this create/update call; 0 means no expiry.

preserve_expiry.description: On key update, preserve the existing exact expiry (including already expired keys). Default false keeps legacy replace-from-now semantics; ignored on creation.

AdminKeyInput.description: Generated key for the specified active owner. Model/limit restrictions cannot exceed effective owner policy.

api_key.description: Required on creation; supplying on PUT replaces the complete credential pool. Prefer dedicated credential CRUD.

price_version.description: SHA-256 of the immutable applied fixed-point price/rate snapshot held by this request. Empty for historical, disabled or unavailable pricing. Does not make this droppable log a reliable ledger.

billing_id.description: Internal durable reservation ID, also returned as X-TXAPI-Billing-ID. Empty outside strict accounting.

billing_state.description: Observed strict outcome. pending means the budget hold remains; cost=0 is NOT a free request. Logs may be lost and are not authoritative.

input_price_per_1k.description: Currency per 1K tokens. Publication converts the API decimal to integer billionths, rounding upward; request cost rounds upward once after token dimensions and group rate are combined.

output_price_per_1k.description: Currency per 1K tokens. Publication converts the API decimal to integer billionths, rounding upward; request cost rounds upward once after token dimensions and group rate are combined.

output_price_per_1k.description: Currency per 1K tokens. Publication converts the API decimal to integer billionths, rounding upward; request cost rounds upward once after token dimensions and group rate are combined.

GroupRates.description: Named group multipliers in (0,1000000], normalized upward to nine fractional decimal places. Omitted groups default to 1.0; empty group names are rejected.

ChatRequest.description: OpenAI wire body is passed through on same-protocol requests. Cross-protocol support is defined by adaptor capabilities; the gateway does not claim support for every OpenAI extension.

last_error.description: Safe publication failure reason; no loader error or secret.

epoch.description: Changes at process start. Revisions must not be compared across epochs.

api_key.description: Omitted or empty preserves the existing key. Never send a masked key back.

reserved_units.description: Exact integer billionths of configured currency, encoded as a decimal string to preserve browser precision.

charge_units.description: Exact integer billionths of configured currency, encoded as a decimal string to preserve browser precision.

can_resolve.description: Strict component ready, state pending and lease expired. The server rechecks in the transaction.

prompt_tokens.description: Raw upstream count; invalid or incomplete usage is retained for inspection and is not a verified charge.

output_tokens.description: Raw upstream count; invalid or incomplete usage is retained for inspection and is not a verified charge.

cost_units.description: Exact integer billionths of configured currency, encoded as a decimal string to preserve browser precision.

cost_known.description: False means uncertain cost, not free execution.

calculated_units.description: Exact integer billionths of configured currency, encoded as a decimal string to preserve browser precision.

charge_units.description: Exact integer billionths of configured currency, encoded as a decimal string to preserve browser precision.

price_snapshot.description: Immutable historical price/rate canonical JSON; not the current tariff.

reason.description: Required nonblank audit rationale, at most 1000 UTF-8 bytes.

evidence.description: Required nonblank verification/approval reference, at most 2000 UTF-8 bytes. Do not include credentials or private request content.

BillingResolutionInput.description: settle_usage/cap_usage require both nonnegative usage counts. waive forbids usage and records cost_known=false. Model, channel group, price version and actor are derived server-side; unknown fields and trailing JSON are rejected.
